answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in lantern, expire in shale, and forge lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 126 aliases as a result needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 120 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
